title: Configurable owner contact details (email + WhatsApp) persisted in localStorage

requirements.summary: Create a frontend single source of truth for owner contact email and WhatsApp number with localStorage persistence, safe defaults, and wa.me-safe normalization.
acceptanceCriteria: A new frontend utility (e.g., in frontend/src/lib) exists to get/set contact email and WhatsApp number using localStorage.
If localStorage values are missing or invalid, the app falls back to the current placeholder WhatsApp number (+919876543210) and an empty/missing email without crashing.
WhatsApp number handling supports common input formats (with spaces, +, dashes) and derives a wa.me-safe value (digits only) for link generation.

file_operations.description: Add localStorage-backed utilities for owner contact details: get/set/clear for email and WhatsApp, validation helpers (email format; WhatsApp has at least one digit), and WhatsApp normalization that derives a wa.me-safe digits-only value while preserving a display-friendly value. Ensure safe defaults (WhatsApp default '+919876543210'; email undefined/empty) and defensive try/catch around localStorage access.

Create a small React hook that reads from the owner contact utility and keeps UI in sync after saves (e.g., via internal state + listening to 'storage' events and/or a custom window event dispatched by the setter). This allows header/footer/home to reflect updated contact details without requiring a full reload.

requirements.summary: Add an Owner Dashboard section to view and update contact email and WhatsApp number, gated by existing Owner Mode (OwnerGate).
acceptanceCriteria: OwnerPage includes an additional tab or section (in English) for editing contact details, visible only when Owner Mode is enabled via the existing OwnerGate.
The form includes fields for Email and WhatsApp Number, with basic validation (email format; WhatsApp must contain at least one digit).
Saving updates persists the values in localStorage and shows a success confirmation using existing UI feedback patterns (e.g., toast and/or inline message).
Refreshing the page retains the saved contact details and re-populates the Owner Dashboard fields.

file_operations.description: Add a new Owner Dashboard tab/section labeled in English (e.g., 'Contact Details') inside the existing Tabs, still wrapped by OwnerGate. Compose existing UI components (do not edit anything under frontend/src/components/ui) to render a small form with Email and WhatsApp Number fields. Pre-populate from the owner contact utility/hook, validate on save (email format; WhatsApp contains at least one digit), persist to localStorage via the utility, and show success feedback using the app’s existing toast/inline messaging pattern.

requirements.summary: Replace hardcoded WhatsApp placeholders in header, footer, and Home contact section with stored owner contact details, including wa.me link generation and optional email display.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx no longer uses a hardcoded whatsappNumber constant; it uses the stored WhatsApp value and generates a valid https://wa.me/<digits> link.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx no longer uses a hardcoded whatsappNumber constant; it uses the stored WhatsApp value and generates a valid https://wa.me/<digits> link.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx no longer uses a hardcoded whatsappNumber constant; it uses the stored WhatsApp value for the button link and the displayed number.
Home page Contact section displays the owner email (as a clickable mailto: link) when an email is set; if not set, it omits the email line (no placeholder text).
All user-facing labels added/changed are in English.

file_operations.description: Remove the hardcoded WhatsApp placeholder constant and read the saved WhatsApp value via the owner contact utility/hook. Generate the WhatsApp link using the wa.me-safe digits-only value (https://wa.me/<digits>). Keep labels/titles in English.

Remove the hardcoded WhatsApp placeholder constant and render the stored WhatsApp display value. Generate the WhatsApp link using the wa.me-safe digits-only value (https://wa.me/<digits>). Keep existing social links unchanged (non-goal) and keep labels in English.

Update the Contact section to use stored owner contact details instead of a hardcoded WhatsApp placeholder. Use the wa.me-safe digits-only value for the WhatsApp button/link and show the stored display number. Add conditional rendering for owner email: when set, show a clickable mailto: link; when not set, omit the email line entirely (no placeholder). Ensure all user-facing labels are English.
